description:
Cast Shifting Wall by paying {0}.
Shifting Wall enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Moldervine Reclamation.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shifting Wall from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Shifting Wall from your library, and gain 1 life.
Repeat.
